items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: he used to tell me about the times he was with Trent, Alphonso Trent. ... Trent in Texas, and he told me some stories about that that were terrific.

ctx.x: : Had he worked with Al before?

Well, no. Well Al, Al used to come around to his house a lot, and play with his children, his kids, you know. And Al was a kid himself at that time. You know, a little boy. And Al would come around there and play his guitar, and Fats would throw him a few crumbs, you know, show him no, do this, hit this chord, hit that chord. So then the thing come up for Fats to do some recording, Fats said well, I'll use you. Do this, do this, and do what I tell you, and Fats used him on the dates. You know.
: So he used Al, who he had known, and he used you, I mean just --
